blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Historical review 2026-08-08 established permissionless local share transfers across the three tracked deployments. Re-verified at Ethereum block 26095807 on 2026-10-01: sendSharesGate() and receiveSharesGate() returned zero; abdicated(selector) returned true and timelock(selector) returned 604800 seconds for both setSendSharesGate(address) and setReceiveSharesGate(address). The exact verified source prevents execution of an abdicated function. Base MetaMorpho and Arbitrum MetaMorphoV1_1 retain ordinary ERC-20 share-transfer code, and pinned asset() reads at Base block 52024171 and Arbitrum block 510584559 confirm chain-local native USDC. Freeze exposure remains inherited from usdc-circle; this review does not remove upstream USDC blacklist powers.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: gtUSDCp has three independent native ERC-4626 vault-share issuance deployments on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum. Deposits and contract fee accrual issue local shares; no direct gtUSDCp bridge representation, adapter, lockbox, escrow or token-specific Across route is currently verified.
